# How-to

```{bash}
# Installation
# Note, this comes with base R 4.4.3 (and several r packages incl. tidyverse 2.0.0 but not incl. deseq nor tximport)
mamba create \
   -p /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/transcriptomics_bbda \
   -c bioconda -c conda-forge \
   python=3.10.15 \
   trinity=2.15.2 \
   busco=5.8.0 \
   transdecoder=5.7.1 

# Add to environments
conda config --add envs_dirs /zfs/omics/projects/education/BBDA_transcriptomics/denovo/envs/
```
